AI-first software engineering,
                shipped end-to-end.
            
            Agentas AS designs, builds, and operates software the AI-native way — from industrial control systems to LLM-driven products, agentic automation, and custom applications, taken from brief to production. That includes private, on-premise AI that runs on your own hardware, so sensitive data never leaves your walls. Trusted by industry leaders
From AI systems to industrial control
Delivered for operators, EPCs, and system integrators on the Norwegian Continental Shelf — and for Norwegian industry onshore.
AI & LLM Engineering
Production LLM-driven systems built to run, not just to demo — agents, retrieval (RAG), tool-use, and continuous evaluation harnesses that measure output against real data. Designed for reliability, observability, and cost control.

Agentic pipelines and integrations that replace recurring manual work — data ingestion, document processing, and scheduled jobs that feed your business systems. The automation discipline from industrial control, applied to software.
Custom AI Applications

PLC Programming
Programming industrial controllers (PLCs) that automate and monitor equipment on Siemens platforms. We build custom control logic, reusable software libraries, and simulation systems for underwater and platform-based operations.
HMI / SCADA Development
Designing the screens and dashboards that operators use to monitor and control industrial processes. We build complete visual systems for real-time monitoring, alarm handling, and step-by-step operator guidance.
Subsea Control Systems
Complete software for controlling underwater oil & gas equipment — from the communication between surface platforms and seabed devices, to integrating valves, sensors, and hydraulic power systems. Proven delivery on active Norwegian Continental Shelf projects.
Industrial Communication
Making different industrial systems talk to each other. We set up secure, reliable data connections between physical equipment, controllers, and business systems using industry-standard communication protocols and cloud platforms.
Custom Software Development
Tailor-made software built to solve your specific problems. From automation scripts and data tools to complete web applications — using Python, Lua, and modern web technologies to fit industrial and business needs.
Commissioning & Startup
Hands-on support when systems go live — both on-site and offshore. We handle factory acceptance testing, on-site verification, equipment testing, and production startup to ensure a smooth handover from development to daily operations.
Private & On-Prem AI

We stand up open-weight models (Llama, Mistral, Qwen) that run entirely on your own hardware, behind your own firewall, with private retrieval (RAG) over your own documents. The same agentic engineering and operational discipline as our cloud work — your data never leaves the building.

L. Cookies
Our website uses cookies. A cookie is a file containing an identifier (a string of letters and numbers) that is sent by a web server to a web browser and is stored by the browser. The identifier is then sent back to the server each time the browser requests a page from the server. Cookies may be either “persistent” cookies or “session” cookies: a persistent cookie will be stored by a web browser and will remain valid until its set expiry date, unless deleted by the user before the expiry date; a session cookie, on the other hand, will expire at the end of the user session, when the web browser is closed. Cookies do not typically contain any information that personally identifies a user, but personal information that we store about you may be linked to the information stored in and obtained from cookies. We use both session and persistent cookies on our website.

main_text_excerpt:
We’re proud to share an important milestone in our journey: Essense is joining Eidra. Read the official press release below to learn more about this exciting step and what it means for our clients, our team, and our shared ambitions in customer experience.
Amsterdam, The Netherlands 2025-06-11
The Dutch customer experience agency Essense is the next company to join Eidra. Essense will be a valuable addition to Eidra, sitting at the intersection of technology, data, consulting, and creativity. The hands-on approach and customer-centric way of working will be a true cultural fit within Eidra.
“We have always admired Essense for their sharp vision and in-depth knowledge of customer experience. Their specialism in CX and journey management fits seamlessly with our existing consulting, design and tech capabilities. Together we can guide organizations even better in realizing exceptional customer experiences and sustainable growth,” says Wietske Rodenhuis, CEO of Eidra Netherlands.
“Together, we can position Eidra as the benchmark for creating greater and more impactful customer experiences and service organizations for our clients”, says Måns Jacobsson Hosk, co-CEO of Eidra.
With a global business and offices across Europe and the US, Eidra will provide greater opportunities for Essense to grow internationally. For Essense employees, the Eidra context will enable both professional and personal development.
“Joining Eidra makes a lot of strategic sense for Essense as the market is increasingly demanding capabilities in technology, data, AI and consulting to achieve tangible business impact with customer experience and journey management. We already see many opportunities to leverage Eidra’s capabilities for delivering even more value to our clients, from strategy to implementation”, says Harald Lamberts, Founder of Essense.
About Eidra
Eidra is a consultancy collective combining consulting, creativity, engineering and data to help leaders create great change. With a unique model for orchestrating our capabilities, we move effortlessly from direction to execution. Resulting in new, more, or better business results.
Born in the Nordics and headquartered in Stockholm, we have brought together best-in-breed companies and built strong operations across Europe and in the US. Eidra is led by active founders and shareholders, in collaboration with minority owner Altor Equity Partners.
About Essense
Essense is a hands-on customer experience agency, helping clients organise a customer-centric way of working, research their customer needs, manage their customer journeys and design their customer experiences. Essense is based in Amsterdam and operates mainly in the Benelux region but also serves some international clients. Our team of 45 consists of consultants on CX, service design, data, journey management and customer-centric transformation.

title: The El Toro Journey: Insights from Co-Founder David Stadler
description: Discover the story behind El Toro as David Stadler shares his insights on the company's evolution and impact.
main_text_excerpt:
Founder, David Stadler, Shares Some of the El Toro Story
Have you heard the narrative?
One of the first El Toro podcasts sits down with company co-founder, David Stadler.
Stadler began his time with El Toro doing essentially everything, being just one of the three original masterminds. Fast-forward 7 years, Stadler now delivers his expertise as Co-Founder and Director of Ad Operations for El Toro.
Stadler sat down to sip some bourbon and share with El Toro Podcast listeners some of the details behind the founding of El Toro.
Read up here or listen in and catch some of the thought processes that took us from three passionate people to one of the most successful ad-tech firms in the nation.
Where it all began.
El Toro is one of those stories…
What started off as three guys in a basement with nothing but their knowledge and hunger for success, quickly became one of the fastest-growing technology companies in the nation.
Despite the rapid growth and success, El Toro has stuck to its roots as a company with the intent to put technology to an upstanding use.
As the founders of El Toro began working together to start their own endeavor, ideas went in multiple directions. It wasn’t until they were along the path to building their own unprecedented technology that they realized, not in this venture nor in any of the founders’ collective pasts had any of them spent money on digital advertising. Advertising is a critical part of growing any business, especially a startup. Then, why hadn’t they spent money on digital advertising?
In the early days, the founders spent their money on direct mail for advertising. They did this for the simple fact that after the completion of a campaign, it was transparent who converted and who did not. This allowed for a true show of dollar for dollar ROAS.
The way most digital advertising works, there is little to no traceability around the traffic that comes from an ad served beyond the click. Sure you can see a click or a served impression and be happy they saw your brand or site, but did they convert? Other than analytics around clicks, impressions served and site traffic, what real metrics do you get to show the transparency of your ad performance?
The founders honed in on how they could move the traceability of direct mail advertising and execute that digitally.
And then an idea was birthed.
El Toro saw more than an opening in the market, they saw a need. El Toro wanted to be able to identify a user online with the same certainty direct mail could identify a user in the real world. This is when we honed in on the IP address.
The founders didn’t like what was going on in digital advertising at large, operating as a massive machine running away with people’s money in an unaccounted fashion. The founders often reference the little to no money charged for high numbers of impressions, as most advertisers know they’re selling inadequate traffic with little success to be reaped from it.
El Toro continuously keeps an eye on all web traffic and daily served impressions in the ad space. The statistic stands that of the 250 million or so people online on a daily basis in the United States, each of those people on average view 60 ad impressions a day. This totals to over 15 billion available ad impressions to take advantage of per day.
The problem with this statistic is, the typical daily average impressions served online sits more around 80 billion per day. This translates to over 75% of the daily ad impressions being spent on and served to fraud web traffic.
People deserve better.
El Toro exists with the capacity to spend marketing dollars and in return, show exactly just how well it worked. We make use of sales alone as the only necessary data to show true conversion rates.
What is outstanding about the fruition of El Toro and our one of a kind advertising technology, is that it has evolved into one of the most trusted and successful advertising methods on the market.
What we are able to do through our patented IP Targeting technology is establish an omnipresence within a user’s home. We simply wait for the correct data to align to show a user online and we then obtain their IP address once we have an established 95% or greater confidence rate. From here, we aren’t limited to Facebook or Google’s network of sites, instead, we’re able to serve impressions to users across the web.
El Toro is exchange agnostic, following users across their journey within the digital realm.
El Toro Today
El Toro took this revolutionary approach to advertising and grew it from IP Targeting to multiple products. Take for example Captive Audience, which gives us the ability for business to business ad targeting, and GeoFraming, which allows us to map places of interest down to the exact square meter to then capture and target devices seen within, and trace them to their correlating home IP address. title: Meet Our Management Team - GI Energy
description: Meet the experienced management team at GI Energy! Learn about the leaders driving innovation in solar solutions and sustainable energy.
main_text_excerpt:
Daniel has been working in the energy sector since 2008. Daniel has broad experience in solar PV, LED lighting, electricity wholesale, strategic energy reduction strategies and project management.
Having personally managed over 50MW of solar PV projects Daniel brings extremely valuable experience to the table and his skillset compliments the rest of the GI family perfectly. Daniel is also passionate about helping developing nations and spearheads our GI Community Division where we supply free solar energy to families who have no access to electricity.
Daniel has been with GI Energy since inception in 2011 and continues to drive the business with the same energy and passion every day.
“If you are working on something that you really care about, you don’t have to be pushed. The vision pulls you.”
Luke Marklew has been a key Director with GI Energy from the infancy stages. Luke had worked for a variety of other solar companies prior to GI Energy, and unfortunately had seen bad businesses practices leading to some of these companies being forced to cease trading. This has been a common trend in our industry, and Luke was able to bring his experience to GI Energy, to ensure our operations were ethical, customer focused and honest. Luke’s experience and determination to run GI Energy as an ethical and honest company, is key to us being one of Australia’s longest standing reputable solar companies.
His role is predominantly looking after operations, making sure all the installations taking place are getting done correctly, in a timely manner and to the highest standards.
“When you can’t change the direction of the wind, adjust your sails.”
Matthew Williams
General Manager
Matt has worked in the mining and energy sector since 2010 in various roles across QLD and NSW. Starting with GI Energy in 2015 Matt has overseen the growth of the residential and commercial sales team ensuring each client receives the individual care they deserve.
Matt’s role at GI extends to all parts of the business, mainly focussing on educating our sales team on the constantly evolving market that is the solar industry so that our options are market leading paired with the finest old-fashioned customer service and after care.
You may recognise Matt’s name as a finalist from the Under 13’s European Maths Challenge in 1999, although he doesn’t like to mention this too often…
“I wouldn’t say I was the best manager in the business, but I was in the top one.” – Brian Clough
James Gibbins
Technical & Operations Engineer
Having a Master of Electrical and Electronic Engineering from UCL, James role is to support and assist our installation teams as well as working with manufactures and technical developers to drive innovation within the business.
James has experienced deigning solar PV systems from 1kW to 2.5MW and has vast experience with a range of other energy saving strategies and technologies.
James was born in the best part of England; Devon. Even though it’s the best, it was still grey and drizzly, so he’s spent most of his life trying to escape. Having travelled to over forty countries, and lived in North America and Asia, he has – as generations of Brits before him – ended up at the end of the world.
“It’s a mad, mad world, son. Don’t try to make sense of it, there’s not enough time. Just laugh and enjoy the ride.”
Scott Boswell
Technical Support and Marketing Specialist
Scott Boswell has been working with GI Energy since 2016 and has an in depth knowledge of all things solar. He has worked in sales, marketing, integration, tech support and content creation. Scott is a passionate renewable energy advocate and loves helping customers save money. He also enjoys educating customers so they better understand exactly how solar works and can maximise the benefits solar brings them.
Prior to working with GI Energy, Scott had spoken to several other solar providers. After meeting GI Energy, Scott realised his strong ethically core and desire to make sure customers are looked after extremely well was shared with the GI team.
“The main object of conciliation lies in reaching a solution to a case based upon morals and with a warm heart”
Stuart Cargill
Quality Control and CEC Installer
Stuart Cargill has been working with GI Energy since 2014 as QLD QTP. Stuart is a CEC Approved Installer and Designer with battery accreditation and has worked on projects ranging from residential size up to over 500kWs.
As well as standard grid connect experience Stuart has also installed battery systems for homes and businesses. He has experience designing and installing off-grid solar and EPS systems with over 70kWh of battery storage.
Originally from Scotland, Stuart had never seen the sun before coming to Australia, so moving into the solar industry was a no brainer.
“Sometimes we’re tested not to show our weaknesses, but to discover our strengths.”

Omsorg for jorden, dyr
main_text_excerpt:
Holistisk Utvikling ønsker å skape transformasjon på det mentale, emosjonelle, fysiske og det spirituelle plan. Transformasjon betyr en forandring av en situasjon, hindring eller utfordring for å gi et helhetlig resultat. 
 Inon sin bakgrunn
Inon er en ansvarlig og naturlig begavet lærer som har en dyp lidenskap for healing og utvikling. Omsorg for jorden, dyr og mennesker er noe som har vært naturlig for henne siden hun var et lite barn. 
Fødsel og oppvekst i Sør Afrika sammen med en åndelig, men også praktisk reise for selvutvikling og selvhealing for tiår har gitt Inon et annerledes perspektiv på livet og de mangfoldige utviklinger vi alle kan møte.
Inon har alltid vært knyttet til de fysiske aspektene av livet. Praktisering, og også veileder, innen kampsporter som Kung-Fu og Brasiliansk jiu jiutsi i 14 år har gitt henne innsikter i hvordan kropp og sinn kan forenes. 
I 2004 startet hun å gå i behandling med plantesjamanisme, og startet etterhvert selv som lærling. Dette var gjort parallellt som hun utførte annen utdanning som massasjeterapeut, Qigong, Shiatsu og Reiki healing.
I 2009 startet hun å jobbe som terapeut, innledningsvis med diverse typer massasje, og med et godt rykte for å kunne gi god behandling og rask restitusjon av sportsskader, spesielt blant hennes nettverk i kampsportsmiljøet.
I 2010 ledet hennes læring om plantesjamanisme henne til Peru for å lære av hennes lærers lærere. Hun var i Peru i noen måneder og har returnert jevnlig siden, gjerne for et halvt år om gangen.
Etterhvert flyttet hun til Norge hvor hun jobber som terapeut v/Holistisk Utvikling.
I 2019 fullførte hun en tre-årig utdanning innenfor en type traumebehandling som heter Somatic Experience og som er utviklet av Dr. Peter A. Levine, basert på hans 45 år lange erfaring som klinisk terapeut innenfor multidisiplænere områder som stressfysiologi, psykologi, etologi, biologi, nevrovitenskap, og medisinsk biofysikk.
Høsten 2018 begynte Inon på sin TRE utdanning som lært av Dr. David Berceli.

Hvem monterer fiberduken?

Blåseisolering vil gi et mye bedre resultat enn tradisjonell isolering. Blåseisolasjonen fyller rundt alle hindringer i konstruksjonen slik som el, vvs, ventilasjon, kubbinger o.l. 3.1.6. Open vSwitch 与 DPDK¶
This document describes how to build and install Open vSwitch using a DPDK datapath. Open vSwitch can use the DPDK library to operate entirely in userspace.
See also
The releases FAQ lists support for the required versions of DPDK for each version of Open vSwitch.
3.1.6.1. Build requirements¶
In addition to the requirements described in Open vSwitch 安装于 Linux 系统–FreeBSD 和 NetBSD, building Open vSwitch with DPDK will require the following:
- DPDK 16.11
- A DPDK supported NIC Only required when physical ports are in use
- A suitable kernel On Linux Distros running kernel version >= 3.0, only IOMMU needs to enabled via the grub cmdline, assuming you are using VFIO. For older kernels, ensure the kernel is built with UIO ,HUGETLBFS ,PROC_PAGE_MONITOR ,HPET ,HPET_MMAP support. If these are not
present, it will be necessary to upgrade your kernel or build a custom kernel
with these flags enabled.
Detailed system requirements can be found at DPDK requirements.
3.1.6.2. Installing¶
3.1.6.2.1. Install DPDK¶
- Download the DPDK sources, extract the file and set DPDK_DIR :
- (Optional) Configure DPDK as a shared library DPDK can be built as either a static library or a shared library. By default, it is configured for the former. If you wish to use the latter, set CONFIG_RTE_BUILD_SHARED_LIB=y in$DPDK_DIR/config/common_base .Note Minor performance loss is expected when using OVS with a shared DPDK library compared to a static DPDK library.
- Configure and install DPDK Build and install the DPDK library:

OVS can be installed using different methods. For OVS to use DPDK datapath, it
has to be configured with DPDK support (--with-dpdk).
Note
This section focuses on generic recipe that suits most cases. For distribution specific instructions, refer to one of the more relevant guides.
- Ensure the standard OVS requirements, described in 构建依赖, are installed
- Bootstrap, if required, as described in 引导
- Configure the package using the --with-dpdk flag:where DPDK_BUILD is the path to the built DPDK library. This can be
skipped if DPDK library is installed in its default location
- Build and install OVS, as described in 构建
Additional information can be found in Open vSwitch 安装于 Linux 系统–FreeBSD 和 NetBSD.
3.1.6.3. Setup¶

VFIO is prefered to the UIO driver when using recent versions of DPDK. VFIO support required support from both the kernel and BIOS. For the former, kernel version > 3.6 must be used. 3.1.6.3.3. Setup OVS¶
Open vSwitch should be started as described in Open vSwitch 安装于 Linux 系统–FreeBSD 和 NetBSD with the
exception of ovs-vswitchd, which requires some special configuration to enable
DPDK functionality. DPDK configuration arguments can be passed to ovs-vswitchd
via the other_config column of the Open_vSwitch table. At a minimum,

- dpdk-init
- Specifies whether OVS should initialize and support DPDK ports. This is a boolean, and defaults to false.
- dpdk-lcore-mask

- dpdk-socket-mem

- Option to set the path to the vhost-user unix socket files.

main_text_excerpt:
Conferring of Distinguished Fellowship on Rita Shah
We’re here today to honour Rita Shah, a successful Indian entrepreneur whose company has become the byword for recycling in Ireland. Her story starts in Thika, a small industrial town in Kiambu County, Kenya, home to important historic sites like the Mugumo Gardens, where, legend has it, a seer prophesied the fall of British rule in Kenya. Born to parents Lalitaben and Mulchand Haria (originally of Mungni village in Jamnagar District of Gujarat, India), Rita is the eldest of three siblings.
Her father, a successful and well-respected businessman in his own right, had interests in coffee, sisal-growing and hardware, and was enormously influential in Rita’s own entrepreneurial journey. The core values he instilled in her as a young child-decency, honesty, respect and empathy for the less fortunate-have long stayed with Rita, permeating her personal and professional life. After completing her early education in her hometown of Thika, under the stewardship of the Irish Missionaries, her father, whose one wish was to see her succeed in business, sent Rita to England to advance her studies. This experience, though invaluable, was not without its challenges. For example, Rita obtained a Saturday job at Gatwick Airport, which necessitated her buttering hundreds of loaves of bread each and every weekend. This experience further instilled in Rita the importance of hard work, determination and the benefits of a can do, positive attitude.
Sometime later, as fate would have it, Rita met an Irishman by the name of Oliver Brady, who was, in many ways, a kindred spirit. Oliver, her father’s one-time employee, became Rita’s friend and mentor and helped her set up Shabra Group, an innovative plastic recycling company based in Co. Monaghan. The company, eponymously named after its co-founders, Shah and Brady, grew from strength to strength with Rita becoming known for her strong leadership capabilities. In the initial phases of setting up the company, Rita travelled to Ireland and spent ten days per month helping Oliver get the business off the ground. Over the years, the duo grew the company into one of the country’s top recycler and manufacturer of bags and sacks with a focus on plastic film and plastic consumer bottles. Shabra, now a recycling powerhouse, is a company with a strong foundation in innovation and a firm eye on home and export markets. Through Shabra, Rita and Oliver have provided job security and peace of mind to its employees and their families, but their journey was not without hardship and financial peril.
When Oliver and Rita first started the business in 1986, their meagre possessions consisted of little more than a maroon briefcase, in which they carried their company accounts, and a transit van with Shabra plastics emblazoned on its side. Not having a proper office to work from, they made use of a phone in an old stable outside in a farmyard near Castleblayney. Rita would answer in her best ‘official’ voice, saying “Good morning, Shabra Plastics”. The English aphorism ‘fake it until you make it’ comes to mind. This self-belief and determined attitude continued right throughout their early entrepreneurial journey. In those early days, Rita and Oliver forewent their wages and lived on nothing more than packets of crisps and sheer determination to succeed. As it turned out, Rita and her business partner would need all the fortitude they could muster. The introduction of the plastic bag levy in 2002 forced the business to scramble, losing a turnover of €2million overnight as clients stopped purchasing plastic bags. Desperate to ensure the survival of their plant and the livelihoods of the staff that depended upon it, Rita and Oliver did as all smart business people do-they pivoted. They worked tirelessly with their clients on packaging projects and decided to embrace recycling. Through a combination of backward and vertical integration, Shabra became involved in the recycling and re-processing of plastic waste film and post-consumer bottles and is now a leader in the Irish recycling space.
Shabra now reprocesses and recycles in excess of 10,000 tonnes of plastic each and every year. The company also manufacturers recycled bags and sacks from waste plastics collected from Ireland which would otherwise go to landfill. Shabra has individual clients in Ireland ranging from blue-chip companies to SMEs in a vast variety of sectors, including the food industry, waste management, local county councils, semi-state bodies, the HSE, and manufacturing, service, and airline industries. While Rita is, as one might imagine, incredibly proud of what Shabra has accomplished from a business perspective, her employees are where that pride is really routed. For Rita, Shabra’s employees are the heart and soul of the company; the key stakeholders that emanate the company’s values. She treats her staff as a genuine priority and as partners. description: Company profile Procuro is a software and services company that specializes in cold chain management for the food and pharma industries.  Procuro offer a range of software services under the PIMM brand which provide cold chain model monitoring, product traceability and end to end visibility to their customers and supply chain partners. main_text_excerpt:
Company profile
Procuro is a software and services company that specializes in cold chain management for the food and pharma industries.  Procuro offer a range of software services under the PIMM brand which provide cold chain model monitoring, product traceability and end to end visibility to their customers and supply chain partners.
The Challenge
Procuro were utilising a number of different hosting services in Europe and the US that were providing Infrastructure platforms for its core services.  The company wanted to consolidate its cloud infrastructure to a single turnkey provider based in the EU. Additionally, the company had concerns relating to data residency, consistency of performance and pricing and ongoing support levels that needed to be addressed by the selected service provider.
The solution
After a review of several Hyperscale and indigenous Irish European providers, Procuro selected Servecentric Enterprise Cloud (SEC) as it preferred service supplier.
The first step was that Servecentric provided a comprehensive Proof of Concept platform in order to facilitate validation of the performance of the service and understand the capacity of the support services included in the standard offering. Following completion of this comprehensive POC phase, the company was fully satisfied that Servecentric’s Cloud fitted the criteria required by Procuro.
Servecentric also made the migration phase much simpler by supporting Procuro’s engineering team at every step.
“It was important that we were able to fully prove any new platform with production workloads prior to making any final decision. We have a growing customer base to cater for in the EMEA region which poses latency and scaling challenges. Servecentric made this process completely seamless and supported us at every step. It was great to be able to do this while having complete transparency around pricing once we completed migration to production” Conor Cleary, VP Operations, EMEA, Procuro
The impact
Since moving to SEC, Procuro have enjoyed consistency of performance and pricing that they previously didn’t have.  Budgeting has been made much simpler with the cost certainty provided by the service. In fact, as the overall compute and storage resource requirements have effectively been reduced by the fact that all resources are undersubscribed and unbundled. The company has been able to achieve greater savings than originally anticipated while improving productivity.
“We are delighted to work with Procuro as they were clear about their requirements and went through a rigorous selection process prior to engagement. Servecentric Enterprise Cloud works very well in the IoT space and we look forward to working closely with Procuro over the coming years as they grow their business.” Brian Roe, CEO, Servecentric

title: GreinDX - Our mission is to detect cancer earlier and to increase survival rates
description: GreinDX is developing a first of its kind, proprietary, comprehensive bench-top system that can capture and study CTCs, ctDNA, and EVs from a single blood sample or from other body fluids.
main_text_excerpt:
GreinDX develops ground-breaking liquid biopsy technology to empower clinicians, researchers, and industry in the fight against cancer.
GreinDX has addressed a fundamental challenge in fluid handling by developing a porous silicon disc that enables uniform distribution of fluids and their constituents. Our GreinDisc allows capture and analysis of single viable cells across more than one million microwells, creating new opportunities for simplified and scalable liquid biopsy workflows, as well as broad applications in biology and chemistry.
The Company
GreinDX AS is developing a ground-breaking liquid biopsy platform to rapidly capture, identify and analyse single circulating tumor cells (CTCs), circulating tumor DNA (ctDNA), circulating tumor antigens (CTA) and extracellular vesicles (EV), all from one and the same blood sample. Such timely and accurate multi biomarker information will become a cornerstone for future personalized cancer care.
We are located in Oslo Cancer Cluster Incubator (OCCI) and have a wide international network of scientific and technology resources. We have partnered with clinical R&D groups at Oslo University Hospital and The Karolinska Institute for early-stage validation, and with SINTEF MiNaLab for development of microstructures and fluidic components of our device.
We have partnered with Vinn Group AB in Sweden for prototype development.
GreinDX is developing a first of its kind, proprietary, comprehensive bench-top system that can capture and study single viable CTCs, ctDNA, EVs and CTA from a single blood sample or from other body fluids
The Problem
Scientists have for decades searched for evidence of cancer in a person’s bloodstream. The ability to isolate and study viable CTCs as well as ctDNA, CTA and EV in blood and other body fluids is expected to become a critical factor in future diagnostic, prognostic and personalized therapeutic cancer programs. However, current solutions are single biomarker focused, cumbersome, time consuming and expensive.
Our Solutiuon
GreinDX AS is developing a first of its kind, proprietary, and comprehensive bench-top system that can capture and study viable CTCs, ctDNA, CTA and EVs from a single blood sample or other body fluids. Our platform also holds promise within the rapidly growing organoid field.
Our Technology
GreinDX has solved a fundamental problem in fluid dynamics by developing a porous surface with properties that enable Poisson distribution of a fluid and its constituents. This GreinDisc holds great promises for liquid biopsies and for a wide range of other application areas within both biology and chemistry.
Our novel liquid biopsy platform that will be far more comprehensive, more precise, faster and come at a much lower price than current products.
Liquid Biopsies in Cancer -
a future standard clinical tool
While biopsies of tumors are currently considered the gold standard practice, they are invasive procedures that typically require surgery or needles. Often there’s insufficient tissue to analyze, or a tumor is precariously located, making a biopsy unsafe. Tissue biopsies can detect the presence of cancer, but they are inadequate for early detection, monitoring patients for relapse and/or identifying the need for alternative treatments.
Several single-biomarker liquid biopsy tests has been developed and some are approved for clinical use. The ability to isolate and study circulating tumor cells (CTC) as well as circulating tumor DNA (ctDNA), extracellular vesicles (EVs) and circulating tumor antigens (CTA) in blood and other body fluids is expected to become a critical factor in future diagnostic, prognostic and personalized therapeutic cancer programs
There is a need to fuse capture and analysis of CTCs, ctDNA, exosomes and proteins into one platform.
Circulating tumor DNA (ctDNA) is found in the bloodstream and refers to DNA that is fragmented from the cancerous cells and tumors.
Extracellular vesicles (EVs) are lipid bilayer-delimited particles that are naturally released from almost all types of cell and, unlike a cell, cannot replicate.
Circulating tumor cells (CTC) are cells that have shed into the vasculature or lymphatics from a primary tumor and is carried around the body in the blood circulation.
Circulating tumor antigen (CTA) are multifunctional protein groups with specific expression patterns in normal embryonic and adult cells and various types of cancer cells.
The People
Welcome to our dedicated team at GreinDX. We are a group of passionate entrepreneurs, researchers, and clinicians, all committed to advancing cancer research and patient care. Each of us brings unique expertise and a shared determination to make a difference in the fight against cancer. We work together, driven by compassion and a relentless pursuit of knowledge and technology that can improve outcomes for patients and their families.

Nordtech Services AS er en teknisk B2B-bedrift i Rypefjord i Hammerfest. Vi kontrollerer løfteutstyr som sakkyndig virksomhet, og driver mekanisk verksted, sveiseverksted og containerverksted i samme hus. NorUS Renewables Powers Ahead with Groundbreaking 4MW Solar PV Project for Leading International Auto Supplier in Morocco
[Rabat, Morocco, 17 January 2024] – NorUS Renewables AS (www.norusrenewables.com), a prominent solar PV developer specializing in the commercial and industrial space, proudly announces the commencement of a groundbreaking project that marks a significant milestone in the Moroccan auto sector’s commitment to sustainable energy. With a visionary approach, NorUS has recently signed an Agreement to install approximately 4MW of solar PV for a major international supplier in the auto industry, solidifying Morocco’s position as a global leader in auto and auto parts manufacturing backed by sustainable energy strategies.
The decision to keep the client’s identity under wraps during the initial stages of the project is a strategic move by NorUS Renewables, adding an element of anticipation to what promises to be the largest solar PV project initiative in the Moroccan auto sector to date. During 2023, NorUS completed a similar installation for Ambemar Maroc , another auto industry leader. Currently, NorUS is constructing a multi-megawatt project for Sidi Kacem Briqueterie, Sidi Kacem, Morocco.
Morocco’s emergence as a key player in the auto manufacturing landscape has been widely publicized both within the country and on the global stage. The nation’s strategic location, robust infrastructure, skilled workforce, and a business-friendly environment have attracted significant investments, transforming it into a hub for cutting-edge automotive technologies and production.
NorUS Renewables, known for its commitment to advancing sustainable energy solutions, is thrilled to be at the forefront of this paradigm shift in the Moroccan auto industry. The 4MW solar PV project is a testament to NorUS’s dedication to providing innovative and environmentally conscious solutions to its clients, contributing to the broader goal of a greener and more sustainable future.
The execution of the project has already begun, with NorUS Renewables working tirelessly to meet the highest industry standards and ensure the successful completion of the installation by 2024.
In addition to the positive environmental impact, the solar PV installation is expected to yield substantial cost savings for the client, enhancing the overall economic viability of their operations. NorUS Renewables is proud to be a key partner in this transformative venture, showcasing the potential for clean energy solutions to drive efficiency and profitability in the commercial and industrial sectors.
Stay tuned as NorUS Renewables continues to make waves in Morocco’s renewable energy landscape, setting new benchmarks for sustainable practices and contributing to the success of its partners in the thriving Moroccan auto sector. For further updates on this landmark project and other innovative initiatives, please visit our website and follow us on social media. Together, we’re powering a brighter, cleaner future for Morocco and the world.

title: Land Clearing FAQ - ShadowCat Services, Inc.
description: ShadowCat services offers land clearing services such as forestry mulching, land grading and leveling, stump removal and more! Servicing Orange City and surrounding areas. Call now for a free estimate!
main_text_excerpt:
What does “Licensed and Insured” mean for a land clearing company?
This is a question we field often while talking to potential clients. Unfortunately with COVID-19 and all the issues that had brought, one of the big ones is unlicensed, uninsured, and inexperienced people entering job markets as a “business” by renting equipment, putting a door magnet sign on their pickup truck, and declaring themselves a business!
This is bad for you…
Someone claiming “Licensed and Insured!” is often simply putting the words to paper with no actual license or insurance.  In fact, most contractors don’t even know what they are actually saying as there is no “license” in the sense of being a licensed electrician for example because there is no oversight in land clearing.  A license in our industry refers to a county business tax license.  Ask to see it from any company you are thinking about hiring.  If they can’t provide a county business tax license, they are not officially operating legally! They will point to Sunbiz.org as their “license”.  Sunbiz.org is a listing of businesses that registered with the State of Florida, however it is not a license to operate in the counties.  That would be the County Business Tax license! You see them on the wall of restaurants, stores, mechanic shops, etc)
Someone who rents equipment is not dedicated to the business and does not do enough work in the industry to justify owning equipment. This is the first red flag towards identifying an unlicensed business. Sure, sometimes a licensed irrigation company will dabble in land clearing for instance, so it is just the first sign to look for.  However, that irrigation company may not have a land clearing rider on their General Liability insurance.  Without the specific rider, their General Liability insurance only covers Irrigation (assuming they have a rider for irrigation and digging!)
So what are the ways to check to see if the company is properly “licensed and insured” beyond the first red flag above?
Check sunbiz.org and verify their company is listed, by name, as “Active”. If “Inactive” or they do not even show up… that is a huge red flag! You cannot have a bank account or insurance without being registered on sunbiz.org! ShadowCat Services, Inc is listed as “Active” on sunbiz.org. We are also listed as “ShadowCat, LLC” which is how we started, but grew into a S-Corp (Inc).
– Ask them to provide a County Business Tax license. This shows they are formally recognized in the County they are based in. “ShadowCat Services, Inc” is based in, and holds a business license in, Volusia County.
– Finally, outside of typical auto insurance, a professional company will hold “General Liability” insurance. Auto Insurance does not cover any damage to you or your property during land clearing, so “General Liability” is needed. Ask to see a copy of their Certificate of Insurance (COI). It should be current. Keep in mind, a company must have specific insurance riders on their General Liability Policy.  The riders dictate what specific area is covered by the insurance policy.  Our rider covers land clearing and grading for example.  However, an excavation company that offers land clearing on the side may only have an excavation rider.  Without the proper riders, the company is not actually insured for any land clearing work!
Being sure to check any company out for these items protects you, but also helps the legitimate small businesses like ShadowCat Services, Inc which are playing by all the rules.
What is the difference between a Bushhog and a Forestry Mulcher?
ShadowCat sold our Bushhog attachment as it could not compete with the Forestry Mulcher in efficiency or quality of results. We are happy to explain the differences however so you can decide what you need!
As for the difference, it’s in the name and it’s in the price of the equipment!
Bushhogs:
A Bushhog primarily is used for tall grass and small bushes. When you see farm tractors on side of the road cutting grass, they are pulling a bushhog. Bushhogs can also be pushed, such as our bushhog picture shown below. However, a bushhog cannot mulch, nor can they handle palmettos or larger brush and trees! Bushhogs are three bladed mowers, similar to a lawn mower so they are limited in performance and quality of results. They can cut down small 1-2 inch diameter trees but you will have large pieces everywhere vs mulch.
Bushhog manufacturers claim to be able to cut through up to 12 inch trees… this is false. Our Diamond bushhog was limited to around five inch diameter trees (cutting, not mulching) and the results are horrible. The Diamond bushhog is one of the largest bushhogs and cost over $14,000… so compare that with people using $4,000 bushhogs and you can expect even poorer results.
The average Bushhog attachment cost from $3,000 and top out at around $10,000. A Forestry Mulcher attachment STARTS at over $30,000 for the attachment!!! A set of teeth for the forestry mulcher costs $2000, or almost the s

As the state’s designated anti-poverty agency, we support nearly 30,000 people each year in meeting immediate needs and moving toward a more stable, self-sufficient future.
Since 1964, we have been a trusted part of the community, connecting people to the resources, opportunities, and support that help them move forward. We work in partnership with organizations across the community to reach more families and ensure no one has to face these challenges alone.
Our Mission
Step Forward aims to propel educational attainment and economic self-sufficiency for multiple generations throughout Cuyahoga County.
Our Vision
Step Forward helps people find hope, believe in their future and take steps to make it a reality.
Our History
For more than 60 years, Step Forward has remained a steady and trusted presence in Cuyahoga County.
Step Forward’s roots trace back to 1964, when our organization was established as part of a nationwide effort to address poverty and expand opportunity. Born out of that moment, we began with a simple but powerful purpose: to open doors for individuals and families working to build better futures.
Through changing times and evolving community needs, we have continued to meet people where they are, helping them navigate immediate challenges while working toward long-term stability.
What began as a response to a national call to action has grown into a community-based network of programs and services, including early childhood education, energy assistance, and neighborhood support centers. Each plays a role in helping individuals and families move forward with dignity, support, and opportunity.
Today, Step Forward continues that legacy, reaching thousands of residents each year and working alongside partners across the community to create pathways toward brighter, more secure futures.

description: Agentas Web lager, drifter og vedlikeholder moderne nettsider for bedrifter og privatpersoner — 100 % på nett, hele Norge. Velg en ferdig mal eller få en skreddersydd side.
main_text_excerpt:
Moderne nettsider for
                bedrifter og porteføljer.
            
            Velg en ferdig mal eller få noe skreddersydd. Vi designer, bygger, drifter og vedlikeholder alt — du trenger bare si fra når noe skal endres.
Fra 5 900 kr i oppstart + 449 kr/mnd (eks. mva) — drift, sikkerhet og oppdateringer inkludert.
Velg et utgangspunkt
Hver mal er en ekte, fungerende side vi tilpasser til deg — dine farger, dine ord, dine bilder. Klikk deg gjennom en live demo, så gjør vi den til din.
For bedrifter
For deg / portefølje
Ekte kundesider
Sider vi har laget, live og i bruk — med kundens egne ord og bilder.
Tre steg, så er den live
Velg en mal — eller fortell oss visjonen
Vi tar en kort prat, du sender over logo, bilder og tekst — eller bare noen stikkord, så skriver vi teksten for deg. Ingen teknisk kunnskap nødvendig.
Vi bygger den med ditt innhold
Vi tilpasser malen til din profil og fyller den med ditt innhold, og viser deg en live forhåndsvisning du kan gi tilbakemelding på.
Vi drifter, oppdaterer & passer på
Den går live på ditt domene. Trenger du en endring senere? Du sender oss en melding — vi håndterer drift, sikkerhet og oppdateringer.
Bli synlig på Google
Verdens fineste nettside hjelper lite hvis ingen finner den. Derfor bygger vi hver side for å bli funnet — slik at nye kunder finner deg i det øyeblikket de søker etter det du tilbyr.
Teknisk SEO fra dag én
Sidetitler, ren struktur, fart og mobil — grunnmuren Google ser etter, bygget inn fra start.
Google-klar
Vi melder nettsiden inn i Google Search Console, så den begynner å dukke opp i søkeresultatene.
Bygget for fart
Nær perfekte Lighthouse-score. Raske sider rangeres høyere på Google — og gjør flere besøkende til kunder.
Annonser på Google tillegg
SEO gjør deg synlig over tid — men vil du ha kunder fra dag én, setter vi opp og drifter Google-annonser for deg. Du velger budsjettet selv, og annonsekostnaden betales direkte til Google.
Oppstart fra kr 2 900 · drift kr 1 000/mnd. Annonsebudsjett kommer i tillegg og betales direkte til Google.
Enkelt og forutsigbart
Nettsiden din som en tjeneste: en liten oppstartskostnad, deretter en fast månedspris som dekker drift, sikkerhet, backup og oppdateringer — fakturert halvårlig. Ingen bindingstid utover perioden du har betalt for.
Enkel
En ren, profesjonell nettside med det viktigste — perfekt for å komme raskt på nett.
- Tilpasset din profil — farger og logo
- Intro, tjenester og kontaktskjema
- Mobilvennlig og rask
- Live på ditt eget domene (f.eks. dinbedrift.no)
- På norsk
Standard
Den fulle versjonen — galleri, to språk og SEO, alt en bedrift i vekst vil vise fram.
- Alt i Enkel, pluss:
- Bildegalleri, kart og åpningstider
- Norsk + engelsk
- Grunnleggende SEO — så nye kunder finner deg på Google?SEO betyr søkemotoroptimalisering — enkelt forklart handler det om at nettsiden din dukker opp på Google når folk søker etter det du tilbyr, slik at nye kunder finner deg. Vi setter opp det tekniske (sidetitler, struktur og Google-indeksering) så du begynner å vises i søk.
- Plass til å vokse — flere sider eller seksjoner
Skreddersøm
En helt egen nettside, designet fra bunnen rundt akkurat dine behov.
- Skreddersydd design (ikke en mal)
- Booking, bestilling eller andre spesialfunksjoner
- Kobling til andre systemer ved behov
- Så mange sider du trenger
- Pris avtales per prosjekt
* Månedsprisen dekker drift, sikkerhet, oppetidsovervåking, backup og inntil 3 små innholdsendringer i måneden — faktureres forskuddsvis hvert halvår.
Ingen bindingstid — du binder deg aldri lenger enn perioden du har betalt for, og kan si opp før neste periode.
Vil du eie siden og få kildefilene? Kjøp den ut for 12× månedsprisen når inneværende halvårsperiode er omme (tidligst etter de første seks månedene).
Alle priser er eks. mva.
Vanlige spørsmål
Eier jeg nettsiden?
Domenet ditt er alltid ditt. Selve nettsiden drifter vi som en tjeneste — vil du eie den fullt ut, kjøper du den ut for 12× månedsprisen når inneværende halvårsperiode er omme (tidligst etter seks måneder) — for Enkel er det 5 388 kr eks. mva, så er siden din. Da får du alle kildefilene (HTML, CSS, JavaScript) og bildene med bruksrett, klare til å legges hos hvilken som helst leverandør. Sidene er bygget som rene, lette filer — ingen proprietær plattform og ingen innlåsing, så du står alltid fritt til å ta med deg din.
Hva om jeg vil si opp?
Ingen bindingstid. Si opp før neste halvårsperiode, så står siden ute perioden du har betalt for — du blir aldri trukket for mer, og forhåndsbetalt tid refunderes ikke midt i en periode. Domenet ditt beholder du uansett.
Jeg kan ingenting teknisk — går det bra?
Det er hele poenget. Du sender oss logo, bilder og litt tekst — vi gjør resten. Trenger du en endring senere, sender du oss en melding.
Hva om jeg ikke har tekst eller gode bilder?
Det trenger du ikke. Noen stikkord om hva du driver med holder — vi skriver og pusser teksten for deg etter en kort prat. Mangler du bilder, bruker vi profesjonelle illustrasjonsbilder

Anno 2008
Norsk Vinfagskole
Norsk Vinfagskole [by Beverage Academy] er Norges eneste offentlig godkjente fagskole for drikkevarer, og vårt utdanningstilbud oppfyller dermed nasjonale kvalitetsstandarder. Som en ledende tilbyder av vin-, øl-, brennevins- og kaffekunnskap benytter vi dyktige faglærere, og våre fagplaner er kvalitetssikret av utvalgte ressurspersoner fra bransjen.
Norsk Vinfagskole ble grunnlagt av Robert Jørgensen i 2008 under navnet Vinakademiet AS. Da skolen i 2010 oppnådde fagskolegodkjenning, ble skolens navn Norsk Vinfagskole. I 2012 åpnet Norsk Vinfagskoles Ølkelner-utdanning. Etter at studietilbudet i 2015 ble ytterligere utvidet med utdanninger innen brennevin og kaffe, er vi blitt en helhetlig fagskole innen drikkevarer – Beverage Academy.

I tillegg tilbyr vi ulike andre byggearbeider både utendørs og innendørs, basert på vår mangeårige erfaring i bransjen. main_text_excerpt:
Kontakt oss
Forespørsel – Kontakt oss, vi hjelper deg gjerne
Hvis du har spørsmål eller er interessert i våre tjenester, ikke nøl med å kontakte oss via e-post eller telefon. Vi er her for å hjelpe deg med dine bygge- eller rengjøringsbehov og tilby skreddersydde løsninger.
Vårt firma er basert i Tromsø, men vi opererer i hele Nord-Norge (Nordland, Troms-Finnmark). Hvis du har spennende prosjekter, ta gjerne kontakt med oss, selv om du holder til i mer avsidesliggende områder. Vi har ingen problemer med å reise for å bistå deg og levere våre profesjonelle tjenester.
For at vi skal kunne gi deg et mest mulig nøyaktig pristilbud, send oss en forespørsel med så mye informasjon som mulig om prosjektet ditt. Hvis mulig, legg ved bilder av området eller arbeidet som skal utføres – dette hjelper oss med å forstå dine behov bedre. Etter at vi har mottatt forespørselen din, avtaler vi gjerne en befaring, hvor vi sammen går gjennom detaljene i prosjektet og utarbeider et rettferdig og transparent pristilbud.
Enten det gjelder nybygg av hus eller hytte, renovering, taklegging, terrassemontering, utskifting av vinduer og dører, eller rengjøring og organisering av lokaler, er vi klare til å hjelpe deg.

title: Team Ragde Charge - Ragde
main_text_excerpt:
Kort fortalt
Team Ragde Charge
Team Ragde Eiendom (nå Team Ragde Charge) ble etablert i 2007 av Anders og Jørgen Aukland under navnet Team Xtra Personell, og har siden den gang tatt utallige seiere i Vasaloppet, Birkebeinerrennet, Marcialonga og andre store langløp. De har også vunnet lagkonkurransen i Visma Ski Classics syv ganger. For tre år siden tok Ragde Eiendom over hovedsponsoratet fra Santander. I løpet av disse årene har de tatt to gule trøyer ved Andreas Nygaard og vunnet lagkonkurransen i Visma Ski Classics en gang. Brødrene Aukland er
innen staking og er kjent for å pushe grenser. Tidligere i år satte Anders Aukland en nærmest uslåelig verdensrekord hvor han gikk 700 kilometer sammenhengene på ski.
Laget er kjent for å levere mer enn resultater i skiløypa. De har også et sterkt samfunnsengasjement og er en viktig bidragsyter for Right To Play og deres arbeid for barn i vanskeligstilte land.
Fra 2021/22-sesongen kommer laget til å gå under navnet Ragde Charge.
Team Ragde Charge blir dermed frontfigurer for Ragde-konsernets nye satsning på lading og grønn mobilitet.
Andreas Nygaard
Oksen fra nord er en av de aller største stjernene i langløpssirkuset. Han har vunnet den gule trøyen to ganger og stått øverst på pallen i renn som Vasaloppet og Birkebeinerrennet. I starten av karrieren var han mest kjent for sine fryktinngytende spurtegenskaper, men de siste årene har han markert seg som en av de aller sterkeste uansett terreng.
Johan Hoel
Johan har markert seg som en av Norges mest lovende langrennsløpere i flere sesonger. Han har blant annet for vane å gå fort i sesongåpningen på Beitostølen. I 2019/20 -sesongen vant han Skandinavisk cup. Johan har allerede markert seg som en sterk langløper og har stått på pallen i Visma Ski Classics to ganger. Han har også en 3.plass fra 5-mila i NM i 2019.
Funfact om Johan: Har drevet aktivt med skihopp.
Håvard Solås Taugbøl
Håvard tok bronse i sprint klassisk under VM i Oberstdorf i 2021. I desember 2021 tok han sin eneste verdenscupseier. Det skjedde i Dresden i Tyskland.
Totalt har han syv individuelle pallplasser i verdenscupen. Den siste kom i Drammen i mars 2024.
Magnar Dalen
Lagets høvding eller Sports Director om du vil. Mens Anders er den langrennsløperen som har holdt på lengst, er Magnar den lederen med lengst erfaring. På merittlisten står det hele 8 OL og 14 VM. Det hele startet under OL i Calgary i 1988 hvor han var smøresjef for Sverige. Det året tok Gunde Svan gull på 5-mila og det svenske herrelaget gull på stafetten. Magnar er den som holder kontroll på alt fra logistikk, treningssamling, lagledermøter, løpermøter, smøre- og serviceteam.
Funfact om Magnar: Snakker fire språk flytende.
Jørgen Aukland
Jørgen er lagets manager og jobber med alt fra oppfølging av løpere, samlings-og treningsplaner og sponsorer. Som aktiv var det Jørgen som for alvor startet stakerevolusjonen. Han ble den første til å vinne Marcialonga på blanke ski og har en enormt lang merittliste bak seg uten smurning under skiene. Høydepunktene er fire seiere i Marcialonga og to i Vasaloppet.

title: Forretningsfører for sameie og borettslag | Bytt enkelt og trygt
description: Lang og bred erfaring innen forretningsførsel for sameier og borettslag og regnskap for bedrifter. Vi tar hånd om dine verdier.
main_text_excerpt:
et tilbud uten skjulte kostnader
Få et uforpliktende tilbud
få personlig oppfølging
Frigjør tid og kapasitet
Ved å bruke Agio Forvaltning som forretningsfører for ditt sameie eller borettslag frigjøres kapasitet og tid fra styret. Samtidig kan styret være trygg på at det legges opp til sunn økonomistyring, og at regnskapsføring blir gjort korrekt og i henhold til enhver tids gjeldende lovverk. Vår målsetning er at din hverdag som styreleder, styremedlem eller eier skal være så enkel og oversiktlig som mulig.
snakk med våre referanser
«Agio Forvaltning har vore forretningsførar for oss sidan 2015. Samarbeidet har gått knirkefritt, og medarbeidarane er veldig serviceinnstilte.»
Randi Alsnes, Styreleder
Sameiet Norbygata 3-9-13
et godt samarbeid er nøkkelen
Proaktiv og personlig forretningsførsel
I Agio Forvaltning er vi opptatt av at våre klienter får tett og personlig oppfølging. Derfor får sameier og borettslag en fast forretningsfører. Dette sikrer at styret kan føle seg trygg på at deres sameie eller borettslag til enhver tid driftes på en fordelaktig måte. Våre forretningsførere vil gjøre seg godt kjent med borettslaget/sameiet, og bli en aktiv partner for styret.
Ved å ta i bruk vår nettportal og modul for fakturabehandling får du full oversikt over viktige dokumenter, protokoller, rapporter og fakturaer – kun et par tastetrykk unna. Gjennom portalen kan styret også enkelt kommunisere med beboere, avholde digitale styremøter og signere protokoller.
et komplett tilbud
alt er inkludert
Vår erfaring er at mange aktører i bransjen fakturerer mye ekstra i tillegg til avtalt honorar. Det gjør ikke vi i Agio Forvaltning. Vår forretningsmodell er at så mye som overhodet mulig skal inngå i vår lave fastpris. Under har vi laget en oppstilling av enkelte tjenester vi opplever at kunder som bytter til oss har blitt fakturert ekstra for, men som er inkludert hos oss.
Be gjerne om et uforpliktende tilbud fra oss for å få oversikt over pakken vi tilbyr – til markedsledende priser.
styret får alle hjelpemidler på ett sted
Markedsledende styreportal
Gjennom styreportalen får styret tilgang til oppslagstavle, toveis e-postkommunikasjon, fakturagodkjenning, et omfattende og interaktivt dokumentarkiv, digitale styremøter, oppsett for saker og sakslister, full beboerliste, leietakeroversikt, avtaler, reskontro, digital signering av protokoller, kalender, egne fakturaer for felleskostnader og systemer for HMS- og internkontroll.
Styreportalen er inkludert i pristilbudet fra oss, og er et særdeles godt verktøy for styret. Alle faste styremedlemmer har full tilgang til styreportalen!
enkel kommunikasjon
Egen e-post for styret, oppslagstavler og fullstendige beboerlister.
tilgjengelighet
Styreportalen er kompatibel med både PC, nettbrett og mobiltelefon.
oversiktlig økonomi
«Live» innsyn i regnskap, og egen modul for attestasjon av faktura.
digitale styremøter
Avhold styremøter digitalt, la portalen genere protokoll automatisk – og signer elektronisk.
en vanlig misoppfatning
Å bytte til oss er enkelt
Når et sameie eller borettslag ønsker å bytte til Agio Forvaltning, overtar vi ballen i det øyeblikket oppsigelsen er levert til gammel forretningsfører. Vi sørger for at avstemt regnskap og nødvendig dokumentasjon sendes til oss innen fastsatte frister, forbereder styreportalen, sørger for at bankforbindelser og regnskap er klart ved overtakelse, og holder dialogen med den gamle forretningsføreren gjennom hele prosessen.
Vi ønsker å bidra til at barrierene ved å bytte forretningsfører er så lave som mulig, slik det bør være ved bytte av alle leverandøravtaler. Å bytte til Agio Forvaltning er derfor like enkelt som det er å bytte mobilabonnement – vi gjør jobben!

prosjektet ditt.

title: People of APS - APS Holding S.A.
main_text_excerpt:
Martin, the Chairman of the Board and CEO of APS Group, founded APS in 2004. He is responsible for the overall strategy and direction of APS Group and its businesses. With over 20 years of experience in distressed debt management, investment, and advisory, he has overseen APS Group’s operations since its inception. In 2015, he became the sole owner of APS Group. Martin earned his MBA degree from the University of Rochester, New York.
Petr has more than 25 years of experience in financial services industry both in the Czech Republic and internationally. He spent 12 years in Société Générale Group and acted also as a CEO of its consumer finance subsidiary in Vietnam.
Prior to joining APS, he acted as a Group CFO of Homecredit, the largest POS financing provider in the world and worked also for PriceWaterhouseCoopers and ING.
Roman has been working in APS for more than 8 years: initially as the Head of Recovery in APS CZ&SK, later in Business Development establishing new APS Recovery subsidiaries and since 2020 he took over also the responsibility for the teams covering ‘Under 5’ investment projects, HR, Reporting and Business systems. And then he acted as COO of APS Recovery. He graduated from University of Economics in Prague.
Viktor is leading the APS investment team in Bratislava and Bucharest and joined the Investment team in 2013. Viktor is managing acquisitions across all the markets where APS is active or expanding and has experience with the wide spectrum of distressed assets. Prior to joining APS, Viktor was working for more than seven years in private equity. title: Om Hammersborg – Hammersborg BRL
main_text_excerpt:
Vi er et relativt lite borettslag bestående av 21 to-mannsboliger som i utgangspunktet var helt like. Dessuten har vi én enebolig som tidligere var et butikklokale men ble bygget om på midten av 1990-årene. Totalt er vi altså 43 boenheter fordelt på Gustav Byes vei, Rådmann Hammers vei og Roald Amundsens vei.
Husene ble ferdigstilt i 1953. Under byggingen var det en stor egeninnsats i form av dugnad fra de opprinnelige beboerne, som i alt vesentlig besto av dyktige håndverkere. Laget er et selvstendig borettslag, men vi kjøper en del tjenester av TOBB, blant annet regnskapsførsel, inn- og utbetalinger, husleieinnkreving og liknende. Videre gir vår tilknytning til TOBB både laget og borettshaverne fordeler som for eksempel rabatter på kabel-TV, telefon og elektrisitet.
I perioden 2007-2009 har vi hatt et større rehabiliteringsprosjekt til en pris på omtrent 26 million kroner. Hensikten var i første rekke å oppgradere huskroppen med bedre isolasjon og vinduer samt en del andre mindre forbedringer. Et vesentlig tillegg var å erstatte gamle sykkelboder som vi hadde ved inngangspartiet. Samtidig laget vi i samarbeid med arkitekt og byantikvar et forslag til standard utvidelse av boarealet. Første etasje kan konvertere bodene til eget bruk, mens annen etasje kan bygge en etasje på toppen av bodene.
De som så seg i stand til det bestilte en slik utvidelse samtidig med rehabiliteringen fordi det var økonomsk gunstig. Det er derfor at det blant husene våre er en ganske iøynefallende variasjon. I noen hus har begge etasjer valgt å øke boligarealet, mens i andre er det bare én av etasjene som har valgt utvidelse, og i noen hus er begge etasjer uten tilbygg. Der hvor første etasje har valgt boareal er det oppført en frittstående bod til erstatning for den husnære boden. Den husnære boden er imidlertid bygget med et fundament som gjør det mulig å sette opp et to-etasjers tilbygg med boareal for begge etasjer. Framtidige beboere skal ha den samme muligheten som dagens beboere til å utvide sitt boareal. De er likevel bundet til å beholde den samme eksteriørmessige utforming som dagens tilbygg.

title: Reparere eller kassere løfteutstyr | Nordtech Services AS
description: Hva skjer med løfteutstyr som ikke består sakkyndig kontroll? Hva som repareres i verkstedet i Hammerfest, hva som må kasseres, og hvorfor det ikke må sørover.
main_text_excerpt:
Hva betyr det at utstyret ikke består?
Sakkyndig kontroll ser etter slitasje, deformasjon, skader og manglende merking, og prøver funksjonen. Finner kontrolløren noe som gjør utstyret utrygt, består det ikke. Da tas det ut av bruk til det er reparert og kontrollert på nytt, eller kassert. Begge deler dokumenteres, så det går fram av papirene hva som ble gjort.
Kontrollintervallet er som hovedregel tolv måneder. Hva regelverket krever, og hvordan du får en påminnelse før fristen, står i saken Årlig kontroll av løfteutstyr: slipp å huske fristen.
Hva kan repareres i verkstedet?
Det meste som er mekanisk. Kjettingtaljer får nye bremsedeler og overlastvern og overhales, og lufttaljer leveres tilbake etter kontroll og reparasjon. Hydrauliske jekker overhales i verkstedpressen. Containere, åk og spredebjelker som trenger sveising, sveises her, med MIG i karbonstål, rustfritt og Hardox, eller med pinnesveising, og løftetestes etterpå. Trenger delen maskinering, har vi dreiebenk, fres og plasmakutter på samme adresse.
Etter reparasjonen kontrolleres utstyret på nytt før det leveres ut, og dokumentasjonen oppdateres. Sveisearbeidet utføres av sveisetekniker med sertifikat MIG 135/136. Hva verkstedene gjør, står på sidene om mekanisk verksted og sveiseverkstedet.
Hva må kasseres?
Noe utstyr repareres ikke, uansett hvor liten skaden ser ut. Tegnene kontrolløren ser etter, kan du se etter selv, før kontrollen:
- Kutt, rifter, slitte kanter eller kjemiske skader i stropper og rundslinger
- Manglende eller uleselig merkelapp, slik at maksimal arbeidslast ikke kan leses
- Kroker som har åpnet seg, og sjakler eller ledd som er bøyd, sprukket eller slitt
- Kjetting som er strukket, har sprekker eller er tydelig slitt i leddene
- Ståltau med brudd i kordelene, kink, klemskader eller rust
- Taljer og vinsjer med skadet hus, brems eller sperre som ikke lar seg overhale
De nøyaktige grensene for slitasje og deformasjon står i standardene for hver utstyrstype, og det er kontrolløren som avgjør. Ser du ett av tegnene over, tar du utstyret ut av bruk og lar oss se på det. Det er billigere enn et løft som går galt.
Hvorfor reparere i Hammerfest?
Fordi utstyret ellers står stille mens det er på reise. Kontroll, verksted og nytt utstyr på samme adresse i Rypefjord betyr at det som kan repareres, repareres her, og at det som må byttes, erstattes fra lager eller gjennom leverandørnettverket vårt. Kunden slipper å sende utstyret sørover og vente på det.
Hva gjør du nå?
Beskriv utstyret og hva som er galt i skjemaet under, så sier vi hva som kan gjøres. Har du et bilde, send det til post@nordtech-services.no, så ser vi på det sammen med beskrivelsen. Er du allerede kunde, ligger kontrolldokumentasjonen i Onix Express.

description: Mintie tilbyr: Ventilasjonsrengjøring, rehabilitering av ventilasjonsaggregat, rengjøring av fett i kjøkkenavtrekk, tørrisblåsing av produksjonsutstyr.
main_text_excerpt:
Mintie er kjent som et kvalitetsbevisst firma som sørger for bedre luftkvalitet og tilbyr forebyggende vedlikeholdstjenester. Mintie har mange års erfaring, en imponerende kundeliste av kjente og solide firmaer, 4 unike tjenester og sterkt fokus på godt samarbeid med sine kunder.
Hensikten med alle våre tjenester er å tilby våre kunder bedre, mer effektive og sunnere innemiljø. Vi ser på våre kunder som langsiktige samarbeidspartnere og gjør vårt ytterste for å finne de beste og mest kostnadseffektive løsningene på deres inneklima-utfordringer.
I Norge oppholder vi oss gjennomsnittlig omkring 90 % av tiden innendørs. Inneklima får derfor stor betydning for helse og trivsel. Dårlig inneklima på arbeidsplassen gir nedsatt funksjon og produktivitet. Det kan derfor lønne seg å investere i et godt inneklima.
Les mer
Mintie tilbyr rehabilitering av ventilasjonsaggregater som forlenger levetiden på anlegget og reduserer vedlikeholdsbehovet. Vi benytter utprøvde behandlingsmetoder med kostnadsbesparende resultater.
Les mer
Fett i kjøkkenavtrekk er et stort problem som kan forårsake brannfarlige, uhygieniske og dårlig fungerende avtrekk. Utilstrekkelig renhold kan føre til rask og ukontrollert spredning av brann fra kjøkken til resten av bygningen. Dette har vi flere eksempler på fra media.

title: Om Skolen | Norsk Vinfagskole  [ by Beverage Academy ] Norges eneste komplette drikkevaredaglige skole | Oslo . Norway
description: Beverage Academy ble grunnlagt av Robert Jørgensen i 2008 under navnet Vinakademiet AS. Da skolen i 2010 oppnådde fagskolegodkjenning, ble skolens navn Norsk Vinfagskole. I 2012 åpnet Norsk Vinfagskoles Ølkelner-utdanning. Etter at studietilbudet i 2015 ble ytterligere utvidet med utdanninger innen brennevin og kaffe, er vi blitt en helhetlig fagskole innen drikkevarer – Beverage Academy.
main_text_excerpt:
Norsk Vinfagskole
Norsk Vinfagskole er Norges eneste offentlig godkjente fagskole for drikkevarer, og vårt utdanningstilbud oppfyller dermed nasjonale kvalitetsstandarder. Som en ledende tilbyder av vin-, øl-, brennevins- og kaffekunnskap benytter vi dyktige faglærere, og våre fagplaner er kvalitetssikret av utvalgte ressurspersoner fra bransjen.
Beverage Academy ble grunnlagt av Robert Jørgensen i 2008 under navnet Vinakademiet AS. Da skolen i 2010 oppnådde fagskolegodkjenning, ble skolens navn Norsk Vinfagskole. I 2012 åpnet Norsk Vinfagskoles Ølkelner-utdanning. Etter at studietilbudet i 2015 ble ytterligere utvidet med utdanninger innen brennevin og kaffe, er vi blitt en helhetlig fagskole innen drikkevarer – Beverage Academy.
Web-TV og samlinger
Våre utdanningstilbud gjennomføres som nettstudier med forelesninger på web-tv og interaktive oppgaver, samt samlinger ved Beverage Academy i Oslo. Denne kombinasjonen av læreformer er optimal for deg som ønsker å jobbe grundig med studiene dine, samtidig som du har fleksibilitet til å gjennomføre studiene ved siden av jobb.
For deg som ønsker en komplett drikkevarefaglig kompetanse kan Beverage Academy tilby en utdanning som kombinerer alle de 4 utdanningene ovenfor.
I en og samme utdaning blir du:
- 
Sommelier
- 
Ølkelner / Beer Sommelier
- 
Coffee Sommelier / Barista
- 
Brennevin Sommelier
Med solide kunnskaper innen vin, øl, brennevin og kaffe vil ingen sette spørsmålstegn ved din faglighet innenfor drikkevarer. Du blir en stor ressurs for din arbeidsgiver, enten dette i pub, bar eller restaurant, eller innenfor import, salg eller produksjon.
Fordelen med å ta disse utdanningene under ett er mange. Du vil spare tid og reisekostnader ved at du i hver utdanning fritas for temaer som tas grundigere i de andre utdanningene. Dvs at i Sommelierutdanningen kan du be om fritak fra temaene øl, brennevin og kaffe, og kan dermed konsentrere deg om vin frem mot eksamen.
Ved å ta alle 4 utdanningene under ett får du også en reduksjon på 10 000 kr i studieavgift sammenlignet med å ta utdanningene hver for seg.
(Fagutdanning – Vin og Brennevin)
Fagutdanningen omfatter en grundig teoretisk og praktisk opplæring innen vinfaget, men gir også grunnkunnskaper om brennevin, øl og kaffe. Dette er en bransjeutdanning for deg som skal jobbe innenfor servering, import, salg eller produksjon, av drikkevarer.
Denne utdanningen er en offentlig godkjent halvårsenhet (30 studiepoeng), og dermed godkjent for finansiering i Statens lånekasse for utdanning.
Bestått Fagutdanning – Vin og Brennevin gir vinkelnernål og medlemskap i Norsk Vinkelnerforening.
Beverage Academy har lenge ønsket å gi et faglig tilbud til profesjonelle innenfor brennevin. Vi har derfor utformet en utdanning som gir en dypere teoretisk forståelse i destillering og produksjon av alle typer brennevin, samt en grundig sensorisk trening. Utdanningen vil være godt egnet for alle som skal arbeide med brennevin innenfor bar og restaurant, import, salg og produksjon.
inkl. Barista
Som den eneste fagskolen i Norge tilbyr Beverage Academy i samarbeid med Norsk Kaffeinformasjon en egen kaffeutdanning. Utdanningen gir ikke bare en praktisk innføring i baristafaget og alle vesentlige tilberedingsmetoder, men også trening i cupping (smaksmetodikk) og besøk på brennerier, samt en grundig teoridel som gir deg en solid varefaglig forståelse. Utdanningen er meget godt egnet for alle som skal arbeide med kaffe i alt fra kaffebarer og restauranter til kaffebrennerier og produsenter.
Champagne er ikke bare musserende vin – det er en kultur, et håndverk og en historie som strekker seg over to årtusener. Nå har du sjansen til å virkelig forstå hva som gjør Champagne så spesielt – sammen med Merete Bø, sommelier, vinanmelder og en av Norges fremste formidlere innen vin.
I løpet av tre kvelder guider Merete deg gjennom alt du trenger å vite for å forstå – og smake – Champagne på et nytt nivå. Dette er ikke bare et vinkurs, det er en diplomutdanning med faglig dybde og smaker du sent vil glemme.
Beverage Diploma
Lånekassen
Beverage Academys sommelierutdanning er godkjent for finansiering i Statens lånekasse for utdanning.
Norsk Vinkelnerforening
Vår sommelierutdanning kvalifiserer for medlemskap i Norsk Vinkelnerforening.
Norsk Ølkelnerforening
Vår ølkelnerutdanning kvalifiserer for medlemskap i Norsk Ølkelnerforening.
Beverage Academys sommelierutdanning er godkjent av NOKUT, og gir dermed 30 studiepoeng.
Offentlig godkjenning
Norsk Kaffeinformasjon er en faglig uavhengig instans for fremme av kaffe som produkt og med høy varekvalitet som sitt uttalte hovedmål. Norsk Kaffeinformasjon er et av landets eldste opplysningskontorer innenfor næringsmidler, og har et internasjonalt renommé for sitt faglige arbeid. Beverage Academy og Norsk Kaffeinformasjon samarbeider om å gi høy varefaglig kompetanse innenfor emnet kaffe, og for at skolens studenter skal representere og fremme høy kvalitet på det som tilbys i serverings- og drikkevarebransjen.

title: Technical Safety and Risk Management — ORS Consulting
description: Technical safety and risk management is the set of activities to identify hazards and assess and manage risks. Technical risk management is a fundamental part of all sectors and industries where incidents and accidents can cause harm to personnel, environment, asset, or reputation.
main_text_excerpt:
Technical risk management is a set of activities to identify hazards and assess and manage risks. Technical risk management is a fundamental part of all sectors and industries where incidents and accidents can cause harm to personnel, environment, assets, or reputation. The main activities within this area are:
Technical risk advisory throughout a project or asset operation to ensure that safety design minimizes harm to personnel, environment, and asset, and meets regulatory requirements;
Risk-based workshops for identification of hazards in a multi-discipline and collaborative environment;
Performing risk analysis to establish risk picture, based on the frequency and consequence assessment, and benchmark with acceptance criteria.
Technical Safety and Risk Related Studies
Escape, EvaCuation, and Rescue (EER)
Escape Evacuation and Rescue (EER) strategy and assessments ensure that a facility is designed and operated away allowing safety for personnel during the evacuation, availability of muster areas, the quick rescue of personnel, and controlled evacuation.
Quantitative Risk Assessments (QRA)
A QRA is a method to calculate and evaluate the frequency and consequences of the major accident hazards for a facility. The resulting risk picture is benchmarked with acceptance criteria and is efficient for ensuring a safe and robust design, as well as compliance with regulatory requirements. CFD is used at ORS for assessing the consequences of hazardous events such as fire, explosion, and toxic dispersion as part of QRAs.
Gas Dispersion, Explosion and Fire Assessment
Process plant layout and mechanical design need to be robust to minimize escalation if a loss of containment occurs. ORS has state of the art software solutions (such as CFD) and expertise for the assessment of dispersion, explosion, and fire (pool, jet, and spray fires) and the ability to interface this with blowdown and flare assessment to minimize the likelihood of vessel rupture in the event a release occurs elsewhere on the plant. Learn more >
Safety Case
A safety case is a demonstration of how health and safety hazards are managed for a facility. This requires systematic identification of hazards, evaluation of consequences and implementation of risk reducing measures to meet As Low As Reasonably Practicable (ALARP) principles.
HAZID/HAZOP
Hazard Identification (HAZID) and Hazard and Operability (HAZOP) studies are structured multi-discipline workshops in order to identify hazards for a system design, evaluate the consequences for safety, environment, and asset, and identify measures to reduce the risk. A HAZOP is typically performed for process systems with a potential for loss of containment. Learn more>
EHAZOP/CHAZOP
Electrical Hazard and Identification (EHAZOP) is similar to HAZOP with regards to identifying hazards and operability issues. However, unlike HAZOP, EHAZOP focuses only on electrical systems. A Control Hazard and Operability Study (CHAZOP) covers programmable control systems (e.g. PLC and SCADA) and IT systems.
SAFOP/SIMOPS
A Safety and Operability Study (SAFOP) is commonly carried out prior to operations to identify hazards, evaluate consequences and define mitigating measures to avoid accidents and incidents.
WHAT-IF
WHAT-IF analysis is a structured analytic technique used to determine what systems, activities, operations can go wrong in a facility based on different scenarios. Based on the answers to the what-if questions, a facility can then judge the consequences of the activities that can go wrong.
Environmental Risk Assessment (ENVID)
An ENVID study helps facilities identify and manage risks related to harm to the environment. It is effective for analyzing waste storage and disposal, emissions, discharge of hazardous substances, as well as the environmental impact of operations. Learn more >
Working Environment Health Risk Assessment (WEHRA)
A WEHRA study assesses the risks to the health and safety of persons working in a facility based on factors such as noise, vibration, illumination, harsh weather or exposure to chemicals or harmful substances. A WEHRA is efficient to identify measures to achieve an acceptable working environment.
